Hi Priya / Amaya team — thanks for the questionnaire and the clear list. Quick answers below; happy to jump on a short call to walk through anything or provide formal statements for procurement.

1) SOC 2
- Current status: Redwood Inference completed SOC 2 Type I (security) in Q4 2025.
- Type II: in progress; we are targeting completion of Type II controls and the first Type II report by 2026-06-30. We can share our SOC 2 roadmap and interim control descriptions now (see attached plan).

2) HIPAA / BAA
- We support HIPAA workloads. We have a standard BAA template and are prepared to execute with covered entities. For Amaya specifically, we can provide BAA redlines via DocuSign or PDF.

3) Data deletion SLAs (primary storage + backups)
- Primary customer data (active and cold object storage): upon a confirmed deletion request (or account termination), we delete data from primary storage within 30 days.
- Backups / snapshots: backups are retained for disaster recovery and point-in-time restores; standard backup retention period is 90 days. This means data may persist in backups for up to 90 days unless otherwise contracted.
- If Amaya requires a shorter backup retention for specific data classes, we can discuss contractual SLAs and tailored retention windows for an additional compliance/operational review.

4) Log retention policy
- Application and audit logs: default retention is 180 days.
- Logs required for security investigations are archived separately for a limited window (up to 365 days) only under active investigative needs; this is logged in our audit trail.
- During restores, backups are handled by our infra team; we do not selectively rehydrate deleted customer records into production unless explicitly requested (and requests are logged and audited).

5) Backups and recoverability
- Backups are encrypted at rest and in transit; access is limited to authorized infra personnel and operations under strict change control.
- Recovery SLA: for account-level full restores we target RTO of 24-72 hours depending on dataset size; we can define more aggressive RTOs under Dedicated or Private deployment contracts.

Attached: SOC2-attestation-plan.docx, backup_policy_summary.pdf
